# AutoGraphForge survivors, ranked by touch number
# NORMALISED: restatements collapsed.
# A conjecture and its algebraic rearrangement are one
# claim, not two: `b <= r + 1` and `b - 1 <= r` differ by
# moving a constant across the relation, `t <= 3d` and
# `(1/3)t <= d` by clearing a denominator. Both normalise
# to a single canonical body. They were reported twice
# because they are generated by different partitions --
# one is a bound on t, the other a bound on d -- so no
# single generator ever sees the pair.
# 82 restatement(s) removed here; each is listed
# in the trailing section with the form that was kept.
# 6522 survivors; 2677 carry a recomputed (hypothesis-aware) touch count.
# Format:  [touch] statement    -- verdict

## Not touch-rankable (3845)
# Necessary conditions `(inequality) => class`: the touch
# heuristic measures how often a *bound* is sharp, which
# has no meaning for a statement whose conclusion is a
# class membership. Listed alphabetically.

[     -] ((((1/12) · triameter) + 1) ≤ average_degree) ⇒ connected
[     -] ((((1/2) · annihilation_number) + (1/2)) < slater) ⇒ K_4_free
